sources.title: UGA Admissions blog: Fall 2027 Essay Question (published May 21, 2026)
UGA Office of Global Engagement: Admitted International Students

notes: Source 1 (UGA Admissions): first-year applicants for Fall 2027 write only the Common App personal essay (250-650 words, any Common App prompt) and UGA will not have a second essay, so there is no supplement. The earlier UGA book essay is gone. International financial documents: UGA publishes nothing for first-year applicants. Source 2 only says admitted students get an email from Immigration Services on how to request the I-20, and that consular officers check financial resources; no document list, amount or date was found for undergraduates (the Graduate School certificate of finances is graduate-only).
